rob-mulholland--vestige.why_en: Human figures made of mirrors vanish into the forest they reflect.
rob-mulholland--vestige.why_zh: 用镜子做成的人形映出周围的树林，几乎消失在森林里。

antonin-fourneau--water-light-graffiti.why_en: Paint the wall with plain water and it glows, then fades as it dries.
antonin-fourneau--water-light-graffiti.why_zh: 用清水在墙上画，笔迹就会发光，水干了便慢慢消失。

timo-arnall--immaterials-light-painting-.why_en: A rod of lights walked down the street draws the invisible WiFi signal as a glowing wall.
timo-arnall--immaterials-light-painting-.why_zh: 扛着一根灯杆走过街道，把看不见的 WiFi 信号画成一道发光的墙。

olafur-eliasson--your-rainbow-panorama.why_en: Walk around a ring of coloured glass and the city changes colour with every step.
olafur-eliasson--your-rainbow-panorama.why_zh: 沿着一圈彩色玻璃走，城市的颜色随每一步变化。

berndnaut-smilde--nimbus.why_en: A real cloud floats for a moment in the middle of an empty room.
berndnaut-smilde--nimbus.why_zh: 一朵真正的云在空房间中央飘浮片刻。

rafael-lozano-hemmer--please-empty-your-.why_en: Your object leaves the conveyor belt, but its image stays behind among everyone else's.
rafael-lozano-hemmer--please-empty-your-.why_zh: 你放上传送带的东西被取走了，它的影像却留在带上，和之前所有人的物品在一起。

kumi-yamashita--shadow-works.why_en: A few abstract pieces on a wall cast the shadow of a detailed human face.
kumi-yamashita--shadow-works.why_zh: 墙上几块抽象的碎片，投下的影子却是一张清晰的人脸。

dennis-hlynsky--bird-watching.why_en: Every bird leaves a trail, so ordinary flight turns into drawings in the sky.
dennis-hlynsky--bird-watching.why_zh: 每只鸟都留下轨迹，平常的飞行变成天空中的线条画。

stephen-wilkes--day-to-night.why_en: One photograph of a city runs from day on the left to night on the right.
stephen-wilkes--day-to-night.why_zh: 一张城市照片从左边的白天一路过渡到右边的夜晚。

maarten-baas--grandfather-clock.why_en: A man living inside a grandfather clock redraws its hands by hand every minute.
maarten-baas--grandfather-clock.why_zh: 一个人住在落地钟里，每分钟亲手擦掉再画出指针。

cai-guo-qiang--footprints-of-history.why_en: Giant footprints of fireworks walk one by one across the city toward the stadium.
cai-guo-qiang--footprints-of-history.why_zh: 烟花组成的巨大脚印一步一步走过城市，走向体育场。

florentijn-hofman--rubber-duck.why_en: A bath toy blown up to building size turns the whole harbour into a bathtub.
florentijn-hofman--rubber-duck.why_zh: 把洗澡用的橡皮鸭放大到楼房那么高，整个港口就成了浴缸。

slinkachu--little-people.why_en: Tiny figures turn a drain or a crisp packet on the street into a whole scene.
slinkachu--little-people.why_zh: 几个微缩小人把街边的下水口或薯片袋变成一整个故事场景。

rafael-lozano-hemmer--pulse-room.why_en: Your heartbeat becomes one flashing bulb among hundreds left by earlier visitors.
rafael-lozano-hemmer--pulse-room.why_zh: 你的心跳变成一只闪烁的灯泡，挂在之前访客留下的几百只灯泡之间。

toshio-iwai--morphovision.why_en: Scanning light makes a solid spinning house bend and melt like rubber.
toshio-iwai--morphovision.why_zh: 扫描的光让一座旋转的实心小房子像橡皮一样弯曲、融化。

berg--making-future-magic.why_en: A moving iPad becomes a brush that paints solid 3D words in the air.
berg--making-future-magic.why_zh: 挥动的 iPad 成了画笔，在空中画出立体的文字。

julius-popp--bit-fall.why_en: Falling water drops spell words that exist only while they fall.
julius-popp--bit-fall.why_zh: 落下的水滴拼出文字，只在下落的那一瞬间存在。

tatzu-nishi--discovering-columbus.why_en: A living room built around a statue six storeys up lets you sit next to it on the sofa.
tatzu-nishi--discovering-columbus.why_zh: 在六层楼高的雕像周围搭一间客厅，你可以坐在沙发上与它平视。
